reason: Survives the feasibility lens with corrections. It is lab only: no submission code changes, so byte-identical-when-off holds trivially, hidden-run time is 0 and no LB slot is used. The builder already accepts '--train-stems @split_ext.json:C/D/E' (build_probe_kernel.py L1579 reads any key in split['shards']). trainlab.py score takes '--split', and gates() reads half_of from that file, so a split_ext.json with stems/half_of/shards scores stand-alone without code changes; a pooled bed needs only a merged split file. All 89 GT .geff are local. Schedule: 30 clips per shard at ~4 min/clip is ~2.1 h, so the shards are done ~04:30 and scored ~05:30 UTC 26 Sep, well before S5 (11:00-14:00) and R8 (27 Sep 12:00). Four problems. (1) The accounting is wrong. 6bba_05db0fb1 is both a head-train stem and a dummy twin, so its 3 divisions are counted twice. Outside exp60 there are 89 clips with 37 divisions: 78 clean (17 divisions; 61 of those clips have 0 divisions), 10 head-train (20) and 6bba_05b6850b (0). The honest bed grows 88 -> 105 divisions (+19%), not +45% or 128. (2) Pre-registration timing. exp60 shards A and B were both RUNNING at 17:51 UTC, with results ~19:15-20:00 UTC tonight, before any 00:05 push. The veto rule must be committed before those dumps are downloaded, otherwise it is post hoc. (3) GPU contention and quota. The Saturday 00:00 reset is unconfirmed (~4-5 h left after the dummies and A/B). Pushing 2 extension shards at 00:05 fills both GPU sessions the K3/K3b dummies need for S4/S5. (4) The veto design is weak. exp60 took the most-division clips first, so all 39 of its clips have >= 1 division, while the extension is the zero-division tail. 'Extended bed agrees on the sign and plateau of t*' is therefore a check across different populations, and it is biased toward higher thresholds. With 17 divisions it cannot show a plateau, so it would false-veto often.
fix: (a) Rewrite the counts: honest extension = 78 clips / 17 divisions; the 10 head-train stems include 05db0fb1 (20 divisions), reported separately; add 6bba_05b6850b (0) or drop it explicitly. (b) Write and commit split_ext.json (seeded, the same trainlab split/half/shard rules, shards C/D/E of ~30) plus the decision rule BEFORE the exp60 A/B dumps are downloaded (~19:15 UTC); otherwise label it post hoc and veto-only. (c) Replace the 'extended bed agrees on sign/plateau' rule with a pooled population check: on the merged honest 6bba bed (39 + 78 clips = 105 divisions, head-train stems excluded), CONFIRMATION delta at t* >= 0 and new-fork precision >= 0.35, veto-only. The 6bba-only DC arc stays as pre-registered. (d) GPU order at 00:05: K3/K3b dummies first, then the extension shards (or run one shard on the sasyami account). If the quota has not reset by 00:30 UTC, drop the extension. (e) Hard stop: if the scored result is not in by 10:00 UTC 26 Sep, decide S5 on the pre-registered bed alone.
realistic_gain: 0 LB directly. It is a veto on one R4 slot (K3b), which R4 already guards with the LB (+0.002 to enter F1), so the value of information is ~+0.0000..+0.0001. Cost: ~6.3 GPU-h, ~1.5 agent-h and ~1 h laptop CPU, all done by ~05:30 UTC 26 Sep if the quota resets.
